newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a very narrow range in slow trading today, with few investors willing to enter the market before a four-holiday starting on Sunday.
The market will trade on Saturday but will close from Sunday to next Wednesday due to a National Day holiday.
"Non-bank financial institutions, which used to be major borrowers, traded little today," one trader said.
Traders expect the rates to move very little in slow trading on Saturday.
